Content: Current validation after the chat/provider/pages refresh is dotnet test MemorySmith.slnx -v minimal with 127 passing NUnit tests. The solution build covers MemorySmith.Core, MemorySmith.Storage, MemorySmith.App, MemorySmith.Benchmarks, and MemorySmith.Tests; the preview .NET SDK NETSDK1057 notice is expected locally. Focused chat/page coverage lives in PagesAndChatTests, including page assets, provider attachments, Ollama streaming, and trusted temp-file image payloads. Benchmark validation remains available through the BenchmarkDotNet search benchmark project, but the normal regression gate is the full NUnit suite.
Title: Current validation baseline
